name: iDev Games Arcade
author: iDev Games

sections.faq:
How do I add games to my WordPress site?

Install and activate iDev Games Arcade, then use the plugin’s settings to import games from the iDev.Games library.

Can I add browser games to WordPress?

Yes. iDev Games Arcade is designed to add playable browser games to your WordPress website without requiring visitors to download a separate game client.

Are the games HTML5 games?

The iDev.Games library contains browser-based games designed to run on the web. Game compatibility may vary depending on the individual game.

Are the games free to play?

The games imported from iDev.Games are available to visitors as free browser games, subject to the availability and terms of the individual games.

Can I create a game arcade on my WordPress site?

Yes. The plugin lets you import games from the iDev.Games library and display them on your WordPress website as an online game arcade.

How do I add HTML5 games to WordPress?

Install and activate iDev Games Arcade, then use the plugin settings to import games from the iDev.Games library. Imported games can then be displayed on your WordPress site.

How do I add free games to my website?

iDev Games Arcade lets you import free browser games from the iDev.Games library and display them on your WordPress website as part of your own game arcade.
sections.description:
Free WordPress game plugin for adding browser, HTML5 and indie games to your site. Import games from iDev.Games and create your own online arcade.

External Services

iDev Games Arcade connects to https://idev.games to retrieve games for import. It fetches XML game feed data including game titles, descriptions, categories, developer names, game embed URLs, thumbnails, promotional images, and game GUIDs. The plugin also downloads the selected game images from iDev.Games.

The plugin does not intentionally send personal information to iDev.Games. The service is used to provide the game content imported into your WordPress site.

For information about the service, please see the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
